mageEdit.label: 1단계 · 교전 동작·배경 통합 · 관중이 있는 햇빛 아래 콜로세움
mageEdit.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the sole subject-design reference. Preserve the subject identity, proportions, and the design and number of existing weapons and equipment; do not invent extra equipment. Replace the static display pose with a combat-ready step toward an off-frame opponent and the actual weapon in the reference preparing its characteristic strike. If it is a flexible weapon, show a tense curved follow-through with the working arm extended and the other arm balancing the rotation; do not add a weapon absent from the image. Only the target combatant is visible in the foreground. The opponent remains entirely outside the image; do not add a cropped opposing body, shoulder, limb, hand, or weapon in the foreground. Distant indistinct spectators belong to the background only. Rebuild the surrounding image as a sunlit colosseum fighting floor with worn golden sand, scuffed footprints, curved stone arena walls, and crowded spectator tiers softened by distance; strong directional daylight and airborne dust. Use a believable scale derived from the reference and enough foreground floor to make weight, distance, and perspective readable. Set the contact points into the sand with shallow depressions, kicked sand, a single consistent cast shadow, dense contact shadows, and warm reflected light from the ground. Render subject and environment as one coherent painterly dark fantasy game illustration, with unified perspective, light direction, color grading, brushwork, edge treatment, atmospheric depth, and scene contrast; neither photographic nor deliberately pixelated. Compose a complete opaque 795 x 596 landscape scene.
